0022600164.text: Dallas hosts Sacramento in the Mavericks' seventh game of the 2026-27 season, sitting at 4-2 on a three-game winning streak with a 2-1 home record and a 7th-place spot in the West. The Kings are 0-6 with a six-game losing streak, 0-4 on the road and 15th in the West, and the teams have not met yet this season, though Dallas lost 130-121 to Sacramento in Dallas on February 26, 2026. Dallas is unavailable for Dereck Lively II, Kyrie Irving, Santi Aldama, Sergio de Larrea and Tarik Biberovic, while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons, Dylan Cardwell, Keegan Murray and Maxime Raynaud.
